name: How long does it take to repair loose tiles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair loose tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for loose tile repair depends on the number of tiles, the extent of underlying damage, and the drying time for adhesives and grout. A repair involving a few individual tiles might be completed within a few hours of work, but the area will typically need 24-48 hours before it can bear foot traffic due to mortar and grout curing times. Larger projects with significant subfloor repairs will naturally take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a few tiles takes a few hours, but the area needs 24-48 hours to cure. Larger projects take more time.
